Which Grouping Variable the Pipeline Will Attribute a Column To

Source: R/read_loa.R
loa_column_owner.Rd

Reproduces the ownership rule in run_group_analysis_pipeline(): Overall first, then each grouping variable in turn, matching the fixed substring _<group>_, first match wins. Reproduced rather than approximated, so this check cannot drift from the behaviour it is guarding.

Usage

loa_column_owner(column, group_variables)

Arguments

column

A statistic column name, e.g. stat_Region_of_origin_esa.

group_variables

Grouping variables in the order the pipeline sees them, excluding Overall.

Value

The owning grouping variable, or NA when nothing matches.
